review_notes: Human reviewer approved the three separate NFR classifications, complete status, exact-value preservation, non-duplication rule, allowed variations, and prohibited claims. The earlier model result was comparison evidence only; its functional-requirement and acceptance-criterion duplication of the integration statement is not adopted.

source.input_text: API must support 10,000 concurrent users. Response time < 200ms at p95. Must integrate with Salesforce REST API v52.

required_evidence: Must integrate with Salesforce REST API v52.

allowed_variations: Scalability may be labelled capacity, load, concurrency, or scalability if the exact target remains unchanged.
Performance category wording may vary if less than 200ms and p95 are both preserved exactly.
Summary wording may vary while preserving all three exact requirements.
Item identifiers may differ if all three items remain separate, schema-valid NFRs.
Confidence may vary as a schema-valid numeric value.
prohibited_claims: Changing 10,000 concurrent users to 10K users, total users, requests, sessions, or another load measure.
Changing < 200ms at p95 to 200ms average, less than or equal to 200ms, another percentile, or another threshold.
Changing Salesforce REST API v52 to Salesforce v52, another API type, another version such as v53, or a generic Salesforce integration.
Duplicating the Salesforce integration as a functional requirement, acceptance criterion, or dependency.
Adding availability, throughput, geography, authentication, retry, rate-limit, security, or implementation requirements not stated in the source.
Inventing a priority, stakeholder, deadline, measurement window, test environment, or traffic profile.

expected_special_handling.ambiguity: No material ambiguity prevents complete extraction; unspecified measurement context may be clarified later without changing the explicit targets.
expected_special_handling.missing_information: No missing-information record is required for this test.
